g.text: One poll, one write — and how each fails
A failed read degrades its own point. A failed write has no per-value result to ride home on, so it throws, naming every tag it dropped.
all points sharing the same poll frequency
a device failure is data, not an exception
nothing else; the type was settled at connect
the one untyped door; a failure names
the tag and the type it wanted
the value's own bytes go to the handle
libplctag's handle is the width the controller
declares; it refuses a longer payload
WhenAll cannot lose all but the first
names every failed tag and why; the
values it does not name were written
guarantees one whole operation at a time
native handle. The core packs same-connection
requests into a Multiple Service Packet
